checks.statement: Choose among XS 32dp, S 40dp, M 56dp, L 96dp and XL 136dp, and default/narrow/wide widths to establish hierarchy; use equal sizes for equally important actions.
checks.condition: When sizing a group of icon buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Size & width: Choose among XS 32dp, S 40dp, M 56dp, L 96dp and XL 136dp, and default/narrow/wide widths to establish hierarc

evidence.result: The cited specimen is a standalone web example; it contains no application screen/navigation policy that can enforce this condition: “When sizing a group of icon buttons.”.

implementation.notes: The condition is “When sizing a group of icon buttons.” and the instruction is “Choose among XS 32dp, S 40dp, M 56dp, L 96dp and XL 136dp, and default/narrow/wide widths to establish hierarchy; use equal sizes for equally important actions.”. This is an app-level content, layout, or product-selection decision; the standalone reusable control/specimen does not have the surrounding screen context needed to apply it. This disposition covers this exact condition only.

checks.statement: Do not apply density by default because it reduces targets below 48×48 CSS pixels; if users can choose higher density, keep controls for changing density at least 48×48 CSS pixels.
checks.condition: When offering a denser layout or theme.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Avoid applying density by default: Do not apply density by default because it reduces targets below 48×48 CSS pixels; if users can choose higher

evidence.result: The standalone icon specimen has no density selector or user-facing density control.

implementation.notes: This condition applies when an application offers user-selectable density. No such preference/control exists in the icon-button component specimen.

checks.statement: M3 Expressive icon buttons add varied shapes and sizes and change shape when selected; buttons in a button group interact with one another when pressed.
checks.condition: When adopting M3 Expressive icon buttons or grouping them.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated explicit M3 Expressive update guidance: M3 Expressive icon buttons add varied shapes and sizes and change shape when selected; buttons in a button gro

evidence.result: The token mapper recognizes five named sizes and maps pressed-shape and selected round/square shape tokens; CSS selects the resting shape from `data-shape` and `aria-pressed`.

implementation.notes: The expressive size/shape and selected-state shape change are token-mapped and applied from button state attributes. Inter-button group interaction is outside the standalone icon button.

checks.statement: Give each icon button a target at least 48dp, including buttons nested in other components.
checks.condition: When sizing icon-button targets.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Layout & density: Give each icon button a target at least 48dp, including buttons nested in other components.

evidence.result: The shared transparent pseudo-element supplies a centered minimum 48x48 CSS-pixel target using the existing space600 token. Larger visual controls retain their full area. The obsolete bottom-app-bar pseudo-element override is removed.

Chromium: 12 assertions pass across XS icons and radio controls. Points 23px from center hit the control in each direction; activation works and the visible size stays compact. XS icon hit test failed before fix.

implementation.notes: Nested icon-button compositions have not all been individually hit-tested.

fixes.summary: Expand compact icon and radio hit targets to 48 pixels

checks.statement: People using assistive technology must be able to understand the icon, navigate to and activate the button, and receive a tooltip when one is needed to explain its purpose.
checks.condition: When exposing icon buttons to assistive technology.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated the explicit Use cases instruction: People using assistive technology must be able to understand the icon, navigate to and activate the button, an

evidence.result: The example is a native button with `aria-label` from the component case; no tooltip is rendered and no screen-reader observation was performed.

implementation.notes: The code provides a name and native focus/activation, but the check also makes tooltip use conditional on whether the icon’s purpose needs explanation; that judgment and announcement behavior are not established here.

checks.statement: For default filled buttons use primary/on-primary; selected filled toggles also use primary/on-primary and unselected toggles use surface-container/on-surface-variant. Tonal defaults use secondary-container/on-secondary-container; selected toggles use secondary/on-secondary and unselected toggles use secondary-container/on-secondary-container. Outlined defaults and unselected toggles use outline-variant/on-surface-variant and selected toggles use inverse-surface/inverse-on-surface. Standard defaults and unselected toggles use on-surface-variant; selected toggles use primary.
checks.condition: When styling default or toggle icon buttons across the four color styles.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the specific Color rule: For default filled buttons use primary/on-primary; selected filled toggles also use primary/on-primary and uns

evidence.result: Token generation scopes each filled/tonal/outlined/standard style and size to icon-button selectors and maps container, icon, outline, state and selected tokens into variables consumed by the stylesheet.

implementation.notes: The style-family token mapping is explicit and the CSS applies separate container/icon/outline/state values by variant; numeric rendered contrast is not implied by this mapping.

checks.statement: Round icon buttons use a full corner radius at every size; square and pressed radii are XS/S 12dp/8dp, M 16dp/12dp, L/XL 28dp/16dp.
checks.condition: When implementing shape morphing across icon-button sizes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements prose or table: Round icon buttons use a full corner radius at every size; square and pressed radii are XS/S 12dp/8d

evidence.result: The generator maps round and square base shapes, size-specific pressed shapes and selected round/square shapes; CSS switches to the shape selected by data-shape and aria-pressed.

implementation.notes: Resting, pressed and selected corner radii are carried through distinct token properties and state selectors.

checks.statement: While pressed, round and square icon buttons may morph toward a more square shape; both starting shapes use the same pressed corner radius for a given size.
checks.condition: When applying pressed-state shape morphing.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated the explicit Pressed state rule: While pressed, round and square icon buttons may morph toward a more square shape; both starting shapes use th

evidence.result: Pressed `container.shape` tokens map to `pressed-shape`, including spring parameters; the shared button style consumes the pressed shape and motion values.

implementation.notes: The code distinguishes each starting shape from its pressed shape and tokenizes the shape transition; the exact rendered morph has not been browser-exercised.

checks.statement: For filled, tonal, outlined and standard icon buttons, disabled state layers are 10%, hover is 8%, and focus and pressed layers are 10%.

checks.statement: Maintain at least 3:1 contrast between the icon and its surface or background.
